data.name: Stratified Ratio Harmonization (Aqua-Preferred)
data.description: Harmonizes MODIS (Terra & Aqua) and VIIRS (S-NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21) active-fire hotspot detections into a continuous VIIRS 375m equivalent series. When both Terra and Aqua exist for a cell-day, Aqua-based prediction is prioritized due to its near-synchronous 13:30 local overpass with VIIRS. A single VIIRS reference series is maintained (S-NPP -> NOAA-20 on outage -> NOAA-21), never summing platforms.
assumptions: VIIRS I-band 375m detection count is the standard reference scale across all historical and current periods.
Aqua overpass (~13:30 local solar) closely tracks VIIRS (~13:30 local solar), minimizing diurnal mismatch.
Scaling ratios vary by calendar month and day/night overpass cycle, accounting for seasonal fire regimes.
S-NPP and NOAA-20 exhibit stationary cross-sensor ratio over annual scales without long-term drift.
limitations: Does not correct for cloud obscuration or heavy pyrocumulonimbus smoke blockage.
Uncertainty intervals widen significantly for small geographic areas (count < 10 detections).
Single sensor detections during sensor outages carry higher platform uncertainty.
NRT (Near Real-Time) observations are provisional and lack final definitive geolocation and ephemeris refinement.
